# Laurent polynomials and rational functions

Types: `LaurentPolynomial`, `LaurentRational`

Specs: [module-structure.md](../../specs/module-structure.md), [laurent-polynomials.md](../../specs/laurent-polynomials.md)

Conventions: 

## construct

- `LaurentPolynomial(variables::Vector{String}, terms::Dict{Tuple{Vararg{Int}}, Rational{BigInt}}) -> LaurentPolynomial` — Store exact rational coefficients for a Laurent polynomial in ordered variables. [contract](LaurentPolynomial.md)
- `laurent_variable(name::Union{Symbol, String}) -> LaurentPolynomial` — Return one indeterminate in an exact univariate Laurent-polynomial ring. [contract](laurent_variable.md)
- `laurent_variables(count::Integer; …) -> Vector{LaurentPolynomial}` — Return the ordered indeterminates of one exact multivariate Laurent-polynomial ring. [contract](laurent_variables.md)

## convert

- `LaurentRational(numerator::LaurentPolynomial, denominator::LaurentPolynomial) -> LaurentRational` — Return a stored quotient of Laurent polynomials or embed one polynomial as a quotient. [contract](LaurentRational.md)
- `LaurentRational(polynomial::LaurentPolynomial) -> LaurentRational` — Embed a Laurent polynomial in the stored rational-function representation. [contract](LaurentRational.md)

## invariant

- `evaluate(polynomial::LaurentPolynomial, values::AbstractVector{<:Number}) -> Rational{BigInt}` — Return the exact rational value of a Laurent polynomial or stored quotient at supplied coordinates. [contract](evaluate.md)
- `evaluate(value::LaurentRational, values::AbstractVector{<:Number}) -> Rational{BigInt}` — Return the exact rational evaluation of a stored Laurent quotient. [contract](evaluate.md)
- `limit_zero(polynomial::LaurentPolynomial) -> Rational` — Return the exact finite limit at zero of a univariate Laurent polynomial. [contract](limit_zero.md)
- `limit_zero(value::LaurentRational) -> Rational` — Return the exact finite limit at zero of a univariate Laurent rational function. [contract](limit_zero.md)
